### How to use
1. First, [install the F-Droid app](https://f-droid.org/), an open-source alternative app store for Android.
2. Copy the repository link below and add it in your F-Droid client:

    ```
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DieGon7771/my-fdroid-repo/main/fdroid/repo?fingerprint=0E369C8CC59A4076FF0BA8902AE4CDD1BD8B8F1C39DBFF95D3659D0D24872C3B
    ```

3. F-Droid will ask you to add the repository. Everything should already be filled in correctly, so just press "OK".
4. You can now install CloudStream (stable or pre-release) from the F-Droid client.
